lines.en: I tap on Molly’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer, prepared this time to inform her that my call is intentional and that I did not accidentally dial her number.
But I am also prepared to have to argue that point as she’s the type of girl who has a hard time accepting that she is someone who can be loved.

Have I played a pivotal role in that by dismissing nearly all of her interests and making her feel less desirable by putting her into a box several miles outside of the one I’ve shoved the others into? Sure.
But am I going to continue to do that knowing full well that all it will take to get her on top of me is some light flirting and nicer words than normal?
Again, sure. Because I have a hard time getting over the somewhat traumatic sexual hill this endless subconscious fight against things that don’t exist has caused me in terms of sex with her.

I tap on Molly’s name in my phone again and hope that things go better this time.
: Mm...Sir...is that you?...
: Yes. This is the first time I’m calling you today.
: That’s...good to hear...because I just had what may just be the strangest ending to a dream I’ve ever-
: Yeah, I’m sure it was weird. But anyway, do you want to hang out?
: Ahh...alas...The dream continues...
: It’s not a dream anymore, Molly. It’s a follow-up to your camping event.
: Camping event?...
: Oh. You mean when you were camping and Tsuneyo was railing herself in the background. But that was- wait! It’s merely 8:00 AM! Why are you calling me this- wait times two!
: You dreamt of me as well, didn’t you Sir?!
: Yeah and it was a really spicy sex dream. Wanna hear about it?
FUCK OFF.
: I have not wanted to hear something this much since the last time Kaguya Luna posted an ASMR video. Rest in peace, my queen.
: Who is that and what is that and why? And also no, because that was a lie and that dream never happened.
: There are too many sections of that sentence for me to process this early in the morning, so I’m just going to go back to sleep now.
: So that’s a no to hanging out?
: Supreme Overlord, we both know you don’t want to actually hang out with me.
: But-
: You just need a healer for a group quest! To which I respond...aye!
: You what?
: Not I, sir. Aye!
: Those are the same thing.
: Damn these text boxes and the way they foil my humor once more!
: I’ll gladly meet up with you, Sir. Just...not right now. The hands moved far too much last night.
: Is that new masturbation slang?
: The hands on the clock, Sir. I was being a dunce again. But do note that I did not declare your suggestion as incorrect.
: Okay. Well, just...call me whenever you’re ready I-
: Top o’ the mornin’ to ye, Sir!
: ...guess.
: Guess what, Sir?
: Nothing. Just having one of those mornings where large chunks of time disappear while a divine voice echoing in the back of my head tells me to have sex with girls.
: That would make a good premise for an h-game.
: I disagree. Too convoluted. Anyway, how are you?
: How am I?
: Yeah. Have you been well lately?
: You’re being weird.
: So what? You’re literally always being weird. That’s like, your whole thing.
: That’s precisely the issue, Sir! It’s not abnormal for me to act in such a way as it would be a cornerstone of my archetype! But for you-
: I do much weirder things much more frequently. I should be allowed to ask you how you’ve been without it raising any flags.
: You can never be too careful when it comes to flags, Sir. And I’m not just talking about Wales here.
: What?
: I just mean that hidden flags show up in games all the time. And since they’re the ultimate factor in determining plot or character deviations, they can’t be taken too lightly.
: You never know when one is going to show up and change the outcome of your story, Sir.
: Are you doing well or not, Molly? Because talking about how life has been for you is the easiest way for me to avoid talking about how it’s been for me and that’s what I’m trying to do here.
: You’re still struggling, Sir?
: Okay well, this was fun. I’ll see you later. Teleport me home now, Pareidolia.
your message can not be delivered at this time. please try again when you’re not such a pussy.
: Pareidolia?...
: That’s that voice I was talking about earlier.
: I understand completely, Sir. The entity commanding my every thought is named Siobhan. It is her fault I am the way I am, not mine.
: I’m going to latch onto the end of that sentence harder than you know, Molly. Also, nice dress.
: Thank you, Sir! It comes off very easily.
: That’s nice.
: I did not intend to say that out loud. It must have been Siobhan.
: Did Siobhan also make our plans for this afternoon? Because if you could ask her what we’re doing out here, it’d be really helpful since time skipped for me and I can’t remember at all.
: Siobhan did not make our plans, Sir. Nor did I. It was you who ultimately chose how we’d be spending my bonus event.
: Well, do you remember what I chose?
: The arcade, Sir.
: Now you’re just taking advantage of me.
: AT LEAST YOU GOT TO KEEP YOUR CLOTHES ONNNNNNN
: I’m not, Sir! Do you really not remember?
: You said you wanted to do something nice for me since you’ve yet to pay much attention to any of my hobbies. To which I responded that such a thing would not be necessary.
: But you were very insistent and I ultimately folded. If you’re saying you’ve changed your mind now, though, I’d be happy to do something else.
: Just being out and about with you is enough of a shock to me.
: We can still go, it’s fine.
I’m just trying to internally figure out why I’d suggest such a thing.
we’re gonna get it wet today
: Are you absolutely positive, Sir?
: Well, fuck me I guess.
: I believe there are rules against that in public, Sir. Not to mention how I can only imagine the effect it would have on this room full of virgins.
: Well, how would you react if you saw a couple having sex in the arcade while you were trying to enjoy being a nerd?
: I think I’d have a much harder time being a nerd in that moment, Sir. I don’t fare well when given such distractions.
: Is that another ADHD thing?
: Or just being a pervert, Sir. I’m not sure if I could successfully remove myself from such a situation as it’s far too close to fantasy.
: But alas! Real gamers do not have sex, so this is not a random event I shall ever encounter!
: Is it really okay to be yelling that in front of them?
: Of course, Sir. For when I am with you, there can be no side characters! Which means no one could possibly respond to such an emboldened proclamation!
: Hey! Screw you, lady! Just because you’ve got a hot boyfriend doesn’t mean you can pick on those of us who don’t!
: Never mind, Sir. It appears that our scenario conflicts with hers and that simply being together does not prevent others from having dialogue as well.
: There goes my theory that everyone else is just an NPC on dates.
: I’m going to go hang out with that other girl. I’ll see you later, Molly.
: Molly-pout, activated!
: Turn the Molly-pout off. I was kidding.
: Not until you give me everything you’ve got, Sir!
: I thought you said there were rules against that in public?
: There are! But that does not change how I’d be open to breaking them under the right circumstances and how that is not what I was referring to at all!
: Then why add that first part at all?
: To reaffirm that I am still level one when it comes to dating, Sir.
: Because, as it turns out, years worth of dating sims don’t prepare you for the nerves you experience when communicating with actual humans!
: There shouldn’t be any nerves at all. We’ve spent plenty of time together before.
: That...may be true, Sir. But it does not change how something feels...different about today. Like I’ve glitched the system and triggered your route early or...something.
: But if Parold E Dolia was truly holding your CTRL key down and skipping the bulk of your day, I suppose I can understand how things may feel more “normal” to you.
: And it’s also highly probable that my impressionable yet highly depraved
: Did I actually say this would be a date?
: You did, Sir. Why else would I ever wear a dress?
: Because you...look good in them?
: S-See?! This is romantic dialogue, is it not?! You do see this as a date after all!
: Oh my God, can you two shut up?!
: Ignore her, Sir. ‘Tis just jealousy and I know it well.
: Now, about this game-
: Are you not worried about being out here with me, Molly?
: Worried? Why would I be worried? Compensated dating is extremely normal in places such as this and the likelihood of someone believing I’m just your hired girlfriend is rather-
: Not about the age thing. About going out on a date with me when you’re fully aware of how little time I’ve spent with everyone else in the class as of late.
: Aren’t you at least somewhat scared that we might bump into one of them and that you’ll have to figure out a way to explain this away while I can just slink back into the shadows?
: Hm...That would be somewhat problematic now that I think about it.
: But I guess I was just so excited to do something like this with you that I hadn’t bothered thinking about it.
: I sincerely doubt anyone would assume that we’re together if they saw us like this though, Sir. I don’t think many of them see me as a viable partner for you at all.
: Is that nerd Molly speaking or self-conscious Molly speaking? Because one of those is unpopular by design and the other one just over-thinks things.
: Despite what my alts would indicate- I am but one character, Sir. And those are both aspects of my person.
: There is not one reason the others would not see me as a viable candidate, there are many. And granted, they are warranted.
: But if there’s anything I know about romance, which there is not, it’s that anyone has a chance with anyone if they try hard enough.
: Yeah, that’s terrible advice and definitely not true.
: Which is why I clarified that I know nothing of this form of magic.
: Did you know I went on a date just like this with Rin once?
: Is now really the best time to brag, Sir?
: I’m not trying to brag, just drawing similarities. For example, do you think the others see her as a viable partner for me?
: I’d say so, Sir. Your camaraderie is noted by everyone, and I’m not sure anyone would be surprised if the two of you were to become more involved one day.
: That’s exactly what I mean.
: So you are bragging.
: I just mean that you two are very similar. And if you think everyone can picture her with me, why would it be any different for you?
: You’re both perverted, nerdy weirdos at the end of the day. And even if people think those qualities are a little more exaggerated in you, which they are, who cares?
: So...the moral is to believe in myself and not care about what other people think of me?
: No. If that were the moral, I wouldn’t have to say anything because I believe you already do that.
: The moral is that you should care. Because it will make proving them wrong feel infinitely better.
: Wording it that way makes it sound as if you believe in us, Sir.
: What I believe doesn’t matter. I’m a spineless husk of a man who will accept any affection thrown at him because that’s all I’ve ever done throughout my time on this planet.
: Well...you are my favorite spineless husk of all, Sir.
: N-Now! About this game...
Molly and I spend the next couple hours playing various arcade games before leaving to go get lunch.
Conveniently, that lunch is located directly upstairs at a cafe built into the gaming center.
So we return to the ground floor for more arcade stuff once we’re done there and that kills another couple hours.
And honestly, I didn’t even know it was possible to spend so much time in an arcade.
But when you’ve got someone as passionate about this stuff as Molly, it’s normally fine if you get caught in the current.
But the thing with currents is that they can be dangerous if you don’t approach them with caution.
In fact, in most cases, it’s probably best to leave the more violent ones alone. For if you’re not whisked away to somewhere you don’t want to go, you may very well drown.
I can feel my feet beginning to slip, and I can’t find anything to latch onto that will not break the moment I touch it. And that’s my fault.
Under most circumstances, it is normally fine getting caught in the current. But no matter how many times I learn not to, I can’t help but fight back at the water.
All that does is tire me out and drag me under. But again, that could be fine if you have someone like Molly acting as a lifeguard. You just have to be careful not to drag her down with you.
: Sir-
I flew too close to the sun again.
: Thank you for today. Really.
: Because even if you didn’t enjoy yourself, it meant a lot to me. And if there is anything I can do to make you feel any better, all you have to do is say the word.
SAY THE WORD.
: Molly-
COME ON.
: Things have been pretty terrible lately. You know that.
UGHHHHH HERE WE GO AGAIN.
: I know, Sir.
: And, to be completely honest with you, there’s probably nothing you can do to help that doesn’t involve selling your soul.
: I have collected thousands upon thousands of souls. Just ask the Lord of Cinder.
: What I mean to say is that this is the peak of what we can accomplish together. We’ve gotten everything we possibly can out of this date.
: But you’ve gotten nothing, Sir. And I’ve gotten to experience something I may never get the chance to again once the rest of the class comes back into the picture.
: Molly-
: Don’t fight me on this one, Sir. I may be level one in love, but that’s only because I’ve been grinding loneliness for so long.
: You won’t ever actually be my boyfriend. And I won’t ever actually be your girlfriend. But that’s okay, because we can still be together in our own way.
: That doesn’t need to make sense to anyone else. But in my life, nothing has ever really needed to make sense to anyone else.
: And that’s what I both love and hate about you.
: Aye...but do you know what I both love and hate about you, Sir?
: What’s that?
: That even though I constantly annoy you...or confuse you...or make you feel terrible with my unwanted advances...
: You still cherish me.
: You may jest...and say mean things about how much of a nerd I am, or...poke fun at the way I’ve lived my life. But that’s just it, Sir. It’s all in jest. So of course I love that.
: But if any of that’s true, and I’m not claiming it is...why would you hate it? Because I don’t think many people would take exception to any of those things.
: It’s because it conflicts with something else I want, Sir.
: It is nice to be cherished, yes.
: But sometimes I wish that you’d just break me already.

: It’s because of Halloween, isn’t it?
: Put it behind you, Sir.
: Come back to the dorms with me.
: We can do something for you next.
